forces.name: Forces: F = ma and the Feel of Change
forces.truth: F = ma. Acceleration is the only thing you feel. Position and velocity are states; force is what changes them.
forces.qfep_connection: Forces introduce change into the system—they are the mechanism by which states evolve. In QFEP terms, forces drive the temporal evolution φΔE(S,t). Without forces, systems are static; with forces, systems become dynamic.
forces.formula: F = m × a → a = F/m → v += a × dt → p += v × dt
forces.demonstration: Feel gravity pull you down. Push objects and feel resistance. Watch attraction and repulsion create orbits and explosions.
forces.description: Physical forces and their effects on motion. Newton's laws in action: every force produces acceleration, every acceleration changes velocity, every velocity changes position. This is the engine of dynamics.
learning_objectives: F = ma: Force equals mass times acceleration
Vector forces: direction and magnitude combine
Attraction and repulsion: inverse square laws
Friction: resistance proportional to normal force
Particle systems: many bodies under forces
content: Forces_Drone_Game: Applied forces in interactive context
